playstyle.identity: Viego is the Ruined King who possesses enemies he kills. He becomes the slain champion temporarily, enabling unique outplays with stolen abilities.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: killing champions leaves a wraith - possess to become them with their abilities. Q stabs and marks (auto on marked heals). W charges a dash that stuns. E creates camouflage mist. R blinks to execute lowest HP enemy in range. Kill, possess, repeat.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Viego spikes with BOTRK and at level 6. He's strong when he gets resets and can possess multiple enemies.

passive.name: Sovereign's Domination
passive.summary: Killed enemies leave wraiths; possess them to become that champion.
passive.details: Enemies killed by Viego or who die nearby leave behind a wraith. Viego can possess wraiths to become that champion temporarily, healing and gaining their basic abilities.

abilities.name: Blade of the Ruined King
abilities.summary: Stab forward; auto attacks on marked targets heal you.
abilities.details: Passive: Viego's attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Marked enemy autos heal Viego. Active: Stab forward dealing damage and applying the mark.

abilities.name: Spectral Maw
abilities.summary: Charge and dash, stunning the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Viego charges up a dash. On release, he dashes forward, stunning the first enemy hit. Longer charge = longer stun.

abilities.name: Harrowed Path
abilities.summary: Create a mist that camouflages and speeds you.
abilities.details: Viego creates a wall of mist that spreads along terrain. While in the mist, he becomes camouflaged and gains attack speed and movement speed.

abilities.name: Heartbreaker
abilities.summary: Blink and execute the lowest HP enemy in range.
abilities.details: Viego becomes untargetable and blinks to a location, attacking the lowest health enemy nearby for percent missing health damage.
